# Orbit: Copilot instructions

`AGENTS.md` (repo root) is canonical: read it for non-trivial work, including what is built, what
is not, and known gotchas. Essentials:

## Architecture

- pnpm + uv monorepo. `apps/web`: Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, strict TS, Tailwind v4,
  TanStack Query. `apps/api`: FastAPI, Python 3.12 (`src/orbit_api`), SQLAlchemy + Alembic over
  SQLite (`local`) or PostgreSQL (`cloud`).
- Web and API talk only over HTTP; shared types only from `@orbit/contracts`, generated by
  `pnpm contracts:generate` (never hand-edit).
- API layers: thin `api/v1/` routes, Pydantic `schemas/`, framework-free `services/`,
  SQLAlchemy `repositories/`, `db/`. Workspace routes use `WorkspaceDep` and filter by workspace.

## Rules

- Do only the task; mirror the closest feature; no unneeded dependencies.
- TypeScript: no `any`, unsafe `as`, or unexplained suppressions; Server Components by default;
  accessible, keyboard-operable UI; only `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` reaches the browser.
- Python: Pyright strict, Pydantic at boundaries, config via `get_settings()`, no swallowed
  exceptions.
- Security: validate input, authorize on the server, never trust client IDs, never log secrets
  or personal data.
- Tests accompany behavior changes; never weaken them.

## Commands (repo root)

`pnpm check` (all gates), `pnpm test:web`, `pnpm test:api`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm contracts:check`
after API changes. Small changes verify narrowly (AGENTS.md "Verification scope").
Conventional Commits, header ≤ 72 chars.

## Reviews

Prioritize correctness, authorization and isolation, data integrity, missing tests, and
accessibility over style; linters own style.
